'''1997 Dagobah Regionals (Mobile)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Dagobah region (Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, Florida).<ref name="nf97dag">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/dagobahqualifier.html A Flood Of Interest: Star Wars CCG Dagobah I Qualifier is Wet 'n' Wild], Jason Winter, Decipher NewsFlash (4 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607092009/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/dagobahqualifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Dagobah)
* '''Date:''' 30 May 1997
* '''Site:''' MobiCon, Mobile, Alabama
* '''Players:''' 19
